title: China's Crude Return: The Next Test for Tanker Markets
section_path: China's Crude Return: The Next Test for Tanker Markets
section_path_text: China's Crude Return: The Next Test for Tanker Markets
summary:
Main
By Panagiota Kinti
China's retreat from the crude market has defined tanker demand in 2026. The real question now: what happens when the world's largest importer comes back, and where those barrels come from. Poten & Partners data show Chinese seaborne imports sliding from 11.8 million b/d in February to just 5.8 million b/d in June, before clawing back to 7.3 million b/d in July.
